svg.title: PostgreSQL: metadata and recovery
svg.desc: Gitea and Harbor share one PostgreSQL 18 instance, with separate database roles and databases.

g.text: Gitea and Harbor share one PostgreSQL 18 instance, with separate database roles and databases.
Ansible and systemd require the mounted data volume.
Plaintext TCP and remote postgres-user login are
Restore base backup + replay WAL to the chosen time.

Data volume and backup repository share pool1.
Instance snapshots exclude the custom data volume. pgBackRest has no configured off-host replication.
